extraction.Name: Louise Beauvais Young
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 17, 1920 by the Farmers State Bank of Crookston
extraction.Buyer: Deed from Louise Beauvais Young and husband dated August 13, 1921 conveyed the land to I. C. Snyder for $1.00 and other valuable consideration. Also a similar deed dated August 23, 1921 conveyed the land to Anna Hughes for $1.00 and other valuable consideration.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739627 issued; southwest quarter of section 3, township 42, range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 2, 1920
